note: Max rank only. The simulator runs at level 60, and a talent tooltip shows rank 1 of the ability it grants -- see docs/class-implementation.md.

spells.name: Abolish Poison
spells.description: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 2 seconds for 8 sec.

spells.name: Aquatic Form
spells.description:
Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.description: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Bash
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Stuns the target for 4 sec.

spells.name: Bear Form
spells.description:
Shapeshift into a bear, increasing melee attack power by 120, armor contribution from items by 180%, and health by 180. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Berserk
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Causes your Primal Bite ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Cat Form
spells.description:
Shapeshift into cat form, increasing melee attack power by 120 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Challenging Roar
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

spells.name: Claw
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Claw the enemy for 110% normal damage plus 126. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Cower
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

spells.name: Cure Poison
spells.description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

spells.name: Dash
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Increases movement speed by 60% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

spells.name: Demoralizing Roar
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 204. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Dire Bear Form
spells.description:
Shapeshift into a dire bear, increasing melee attack power by 180, armor contribution from items by 360%, and health by 1,240. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Enrage
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

spells.name: Entangling Roots
spells.description: Roots the target in place and causes 234 Nature damage over 27 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. You may only have 1 target Rooted at a time.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Decrease the armor of the target by 505 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

spells.name: Feline Grace
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Reduces damage from falling.

spells.name: Feral Charge
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description:
Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec.

Leap behind an enemy.

spells.name: Ferocious Bite
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 2.7 additional damage. Damage is increased by your Attack Power.
 1 point : 199-259 damage
 2 points: 346-406 damage
 3 points: 493-553 damage
 4 points: 640-700 damage
 5 points: 787-847 damage

spells.name: Frenzied Regeneration
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Converts up to 10 Rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of Rage is converted into 1% health.

spells.name: Gift of the Wild
spells.description: Gives the Gift of the Wild to all party and raid members, increasing armor by 385, all attributes by 16 and all resistances by 27 for 1 hour.

spells.name: Growl
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

spells.name: Healing Touch
spells.description: Heals a friendly target for 2,139 to 2,525.

spells.name: Hibernate
spells.description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

spells.name: Hurricane
spells.description: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 132 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

spells.name: Innervate
spells.description: Increases the target's Mana regeneration by 400% and allows 100% of the target's Mana regeneration to continue while casting. Lasts 20 sec.

spells.name: Insect Swarm
spells.description: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 186 Nature damage over 12 sec.

spells.name: Lacerate
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 75 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

spells.name: Mark of the Wild
spells.description: Increases the friendly target's armor by 385, all attributes by 16 and all resistances by 27 for 1 hour.

spells.name: Maul
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Increases the druid's next attack by 128 damage.

spells.name: Moonfire
spells.description: Burns the enemy for 128 to 150 Arcane damage and then an additional 240 Arcane damage over 12 sec.

spells.name: Moonkin Form
spells.description:
Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form. While in this form, the armor contribution from items is increased by 360%, Omen of Clarity gains 100% increased chance to trigger, and all party members within 45 yards have their critical strike chance increased by 3%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack. The Moonkin cannot cast healing spells while shapeshifted.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Nature's Grasp
spells.description: The next 1 melee attack that strikes the caster will afflict the attacker with Entangling Roots (Rank 6). Castable while shapeshifted. Lasts 45 sec.

spells.name: Nature's Swiftness
spells.description: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

spells.name: Omen of Clarity
spells.description: Your spells and attacks have a chance to grant you Clearcasting, reducing the Mana, Rage, or Energy cost of your next damage or healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. Clearcasting is not consumed by Wrath or by spells or abilities that cost no resources.

spells.name: Pounce
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Pounce, stunning the target for 2 sec and causing 150 damage over 18 sec. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Primal Bite
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Bite the target for 100% normal damage plus 77.

spells.name: Prowl
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

spells.name: Rake
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Rake the target for 61 damage and an additional 102 damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Ravage
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Ravage the target, causing 350% damage plus 343 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Rebirth
spells.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 2,200 health and 2,800 mana.

spells.name: Regrowth
spells.description: Heals a friendly target for 965 to 1,077 and another 994 over 21 sec.

spells.name: Rejuvenation
spells.description: Heals the target for 776 over 12 sec.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.description: Dispels 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

spells.name: Revive
spells.description: Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1,000 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

spells.name: Rip
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description:
Finishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power:
 1 point : 243 damage over 12 sec.
 2 points: 396 damage over 12 sec.
 3 points: 549 damage over 12 sec.
 4 points: 702 damage over 12 sec.
 5 points: 855 damage over 12 sec.

spells.name: Shred
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Shred the target, causing 155% damage plus 180 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Soothe Animal
spells.description: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Beast targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Starfire
spells.description: Causes 350 to 412 Arcane damage to the target.

spells.name: Swiftmend
spells.description: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

spells.name: Swipe
spells.requires: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
spells.description: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 83 damage.

spells.name: Teleport: Moonglade
spells.description: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

spells.name: Thorns
spells.description: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 22 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Tiger's Fury
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Increases Physical damage done by 15% for 6 sec.

spells.name: Track Humanoids
spells.requires: Requires Cat Form
spells.description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.

spells.name: Tranquility
spells.description: Regenerates all nearby party members within 20 yards for 285 every 2 sec for 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

spells.name: Travel Form
spells.description:
Transforms the druid into a travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Wild Growth
spells.description: Heals the target and their party for 679 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

spells.name: Wrath
spells.description: Causes 92 to 102 Nature damage to the target.
